terminology_findings.reason: Transparent compound from recovery/restoration plus copy. It identifies a copy retained for possible recovery, not proof that restoration succeeded. terminology_findings.reason: Appropriate selection terminology and independently attested in official GIMP Nynorsk documentation. Production supports one optional floating selection; final message uses eit eventuelt flytande utval. This does not imply cross-application behavior is identical.

Angrelogg denotes undo history; mellomlager for angring denotes on-disk snapshot cache. Official GIMP Nynorsk documents angrelogg, but AN Paint storage/RAM semantics were checked in this app’s source, not imported from GIMP.
